source: Recovered V28 standalone, exact prior app engine and 146-record dataset

ten_screenshots.diagnostic_goal: Zoan front: golden crescent wing connection, canopy, hanging fruits
Logia front: curved fire canopy, storm vortex, rooted glacier
Paramecia front: ivory-pink braid, sakura depth, base portal
Zoan 135-degree elevated rear: radial support, roots, foliage depth
Logia 235-degree elevated rear: storm-vortex depth, ice, flame backside
Paramecia 80-degree elevated side: canopy back, flower and orbit thickness
Tori Tori family low orbit: physical bough attachment and marker
Substance Creation family side: fruit size, spacing and tap targets
Awa Awa fruit angled: illustrated 3D surface and data legibility
Numa Numa opposite angle: sealed chain, lock and data legibility

limitations: The three supplied reference pictures are rendered concept art, not original 3D source models
The 146 project records are historical and not verified as complete current manga canon
Only 23 historically illustrated fruit forms are stylised interpretations; 123 are sealed as unverified
Local Chromium software WebGL is not sustained real Android GPU performance
Third-party hosting and external preview are not tested by this local browser run
source_provenance: V28 materialized from file library; preserved original 146 records, engine and navigation

Zoan: Dense radial green crown with rear depth
Colourful embossed hero fruit with curling stems
Logia: Cyan water currents and connected ice fan
Paramecia: Sakura and lotus canopies in multiple Z planes
Limited golden spatial ring and purple rooted portal

visual_issues_fixed: Reinstated restrained golden Ancient Zoan crescent wings in front of crown rather than hiding behind foliage
Raised and redistributed physical family bunches from trunk bottom to real crown boughs
Enlarged one representative fruit per family, with multicolour swirl surface and golden curling stems; all other members retained
Replaced front-facing narrow fire triangles with bent broad 3D flame tongues, enlarged integrated storm/vortex and ice
Rebuilt Paramecia in contrasting ivory and rose wood with multiple broad sakura crowns, fewer dimensional lotus accents and a root portal
Expanded actual rear/front branches for XYZ depth, avoiding width-only silhouettes
Changed waterfalls from narrow pipes to wider faceted blue 3D waterfall sheets and softened their flow
Corrected canopy side normals so directional lighting shows bright green/pink facets
Fixed pinch gesture ending from mistakenly triggering a tap, and raised orbit zoom maximum for the larger tree meshes
Shrunk the family close-up bough and enlarged inspectable family fruits while preserving small icon-only navigation
visual_issues_outstanding: Polished 2D reference artwork has considerably more detail than V29 procedural sculptures; direct concept-art fidelity is not achieved
Zoan rounded foliage remains visibly repeating low-poly crowns from some angles
Logia fire tongues are broad geometric folded meshes and could be sculpted much more organically
Paramecia still lacks the reference image’s rich layered cherry blossom detail and sweeping physically continuous ivory trunk accents
Background clouds, roots and waterfall geometry remain simple; full mobile performance unmeasured
Individual illustrated fruit forms and canon content need a reference-backed audit
